title: Khooke bhai ko aayi hoon amma
body:
KHOKE BHAYE KO AAYI HOON AMMA
KHOON BHARA KURTA LAAYI HOON AMMA
Bekafan tha Hussain ka lasha
Tha na koi bhi poochne wala
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash pamaal kargaye aada
Qabr Shai ki banayi hoon amma
Tauq beemar ko bhi pehnaya Aur kaanto’n pa usko chalwaya
Taziyane ghareeb ko maara
<<DIVIDER>>
Sehke har zulm aayi hoon amma
Baad-e-Ashoor qaid hoke rahe
Karke aada aseer humko chale
Ek rasan mein bandhe the baara (12) gale
<<DIVIDER>>
Taziyane mai khaayi hoon amma
Ek dil par hazaar hain sadme
Pusht zakhmi hai taziyano se
Neele ab tak bhi hai mere shane
<<DIVIDER>>
Mai ye saughaat layi hoon amma
Karb-o-Aalam se mai hoke chali
Koofa-o-Sham se mai hoke chali
Balwa-e-Aam se mai hoke chali
<<DIVIDER>>
Daagh dil par uthaayi hoon amma
Thi aziyat ki inteha amma
Sar khula tha na thi rida amma
Yaad Abbas aagaya amma
<<DIVIDER>>
Dil pa sadme uthaayi hoon amma
Khoon jari tha kaan the zakhmi
Khauf se shumr ke wo thi sehmi
Ghutke zindaa’n mein margayi bachchi
<<DIVIDER>>
Khoke zindaa’n mein aayi hoon amma
Har khadam par Ali qayamat thi
Raah mein the Adu tamashayi
Bint-e-Zehra lahad pa Zehra ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Keh rahi thi mai aayi hoon amma
